turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
US orders: reach out ideally 10 days or more before the estimated arrival date
Canada orders: reach out ideally 10 days or more before the scheduled ship week

If the order has already shipped, it can’t be canceled in the usual way. In some cases, our team may be able to request a recall back to the nursery before delivery, and a $22 per box carrier recall fee would apply.

If you want, send me your order number and the email used at checkout, and I can help with the next step.

turns.replyText:
Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?

Hi, yes, orders can sometimes be canceled after they’re placed, but timing matters.

For the best chance of making a change, contact us as soon as possible. In general:

US orders: reach out ideally 10 days or more before the estimated arrival date
Canada orders: reach out ideally 10 days or more before the scheduled ship week

If the order has already shipped, it can’t be canceled in the usual way. In some cases, our team may be able to request a recall back to the nursery before delivery, and a $22 per box carrier recall fee would apply.

If you want, send me your order number and the email used at checkout, and I can help with the next step.

What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?

Hi, once an order has already shipped, it generally can’t be changed. Changes also can’t be made once it has entered processing.

If you need help with the order anyway, please call our Customer Care team at (800) 820-0465. Our hours are Monday–Friday 6:00AM – 4:00PM and Saturday 8:00AM – 4:00PM PST.

turns.replyText:
How do I update my contact or account details?

You have a couple of options, depending on what you want to update.

1. Update details in your online account

For things like your name, default shipping address, and phone number:

Log in at our website.
Go to your account/profile area.
Edit your saved addresses and contact info, then save your changes.

Those updates will apply to future orders placed while you’re logged in.

2. Change the email on your account or an existing order

If you’d like us to update your email address in our system, I can have our team handle that for you.

Please reply with:

Your full name
The previous email address on the account/order
The new email address you want to use

Once I have that, I’ll redirect this to our garden advisors so they can process the change. Our team will follow up with you via email within 1 business day. For assistance with this by phone instead, you can also reach our garden advisors at (800) 820-0465, Monday–Friday 6:00AM – 4:00PM and Saturday 8:00AM – 4:00PM PST.
